analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: US Quant Pauses; Japan ELS “On” & Quant Resumes; Hyperscalers Bgt
key_insights: The UBS US Quant deleveraging indicator paused after being active for all five sessions last week. Quants still cut a further 0.7 standard deviations of gross exposure yesterday, and UBS's model foresees further deleveraging today.
Quant performance remains weak at -48bps yesterday.
The US Equity L/S deleveraging indicator paused on Friday last week.
In Japan the Equity L/S indicator remains switched on, and the Quant indicator has resumed because of poor performance.
Equity L/S hedge funds supported yesterday's US rally with net buying of +1std, split roughly 50/50 between long buying and short covering.
US flow was driven by long buying in Hyperscalers (+2.3std) and US Software (+2.1std), and by covering and long buying in US Transportation (+2.4std).
By factor, flow stayed skewed to High Quality names (+2.3std).
UBS estimates US Equity L/S performance at -64bps yesterday. Funds were caught offside by the rally after heavily de-risking earlier and adding hedging shorts in Industrials and Tech.

European hedge funds were de-grossing, with -1.0std of European equities de-risked. Long exposure was sold down by -1.1std, concentrated in profit taking in Tech & Hardware, which lifted performance by +80bps on the day.
European hedge funds also covered short exposure by +0.5std, concentrated in Food, Bevs & Tobacco as the sector squeezed higher.
risk_factors: Further quant deleveraging today, per UBS's model, after a -48bps quant performance day.
US Equity L/S funds were caught offside by the rally after heavily de-risking, with performance estimated at -64bps yesterday.
Japan quant performance is tough enough to have resumed the Japan Quant deleveraging indicator.
vol_and_positioning: UBS US Quant deleveraging indicator paused after five active sessions last week. Quants cut a further 0.7std of gross yesterday and the model foresees more deleveraging today.
US Equity L/S indicator paused on Friday last week. Japan Equity L/S indicator remains on and the Japan Quant indicator has resumed.

US Equity L/S net bought +1std of US equities yesterday, split about 50/50 long buying and covering. Buying was concentrated in Hyperscalers (+2.3std), US Software (+2.1std) and US Transportation (+2.4std, covering and long buying).
Factor flow was skewed to High Quality (+2.3std).
US Equity L/S had heavily de-risked beforehand and added hedging shorts to Industrials and Tech.
Europe saw de-grossing of -1.0std. Long selling was -1.1std, concentrated in Tech & Hardware profit taking. Short covering was +0.5std, concentrated in Food, Bevs & Tobacco.
